season.sr: Zaliv je otvoren cele godine, a zidine i brodići najviše se obilaze od aprila do oktobra.
season.en: The bay is open year-round, but the walls and boat trips are at their best from April to October.

tagline.sr: Plavi zaliv pod strmim liticama, sa šetnjom kroz kameni stari grad i vožnjom brodićem do Perasta.
tagline.en: A blue fjord-like bay beneath steep cliffs, with a stone old town and a boat ride to Perast.

description.sr: Boka Kotorska je najlepši „fjord“ Jadrana — dubok zaliv okružen visokim planinama, sa starim gradom Kotorom pod zaštitom UNESKO-a. Za male noge idealna je lagana šetnja kamenim ulicama Kotora, gde mačke i fontane zabavljaju mališane dok roditelji uživaju u kafi na trgu. Brodićem do Perasta i ostrvceta Gospa od Škrpjela stiže se brzo i bez umora. Plivanje je moguće na uređenim plažama uz zaliv, a najlepši pogled čeka i bez ijednog stepenika.
description.en: The Bay of Kotor is the Adriatic's most beautiful 'fjord' — a deep bay ringed by mountains, with the UNESCO-listed old town of Kotor at its heart. A gentle stroll through Kotor's stone lanes keeps little legs happy (cats and fountains do the entertaining) while parents enjoy coffee on the square. A short boat trip takes you to Perast and the tiny island of Our Lady of the Rocks without any walking. Swimming is possible at the bay's small beaches, and the best photo views need no hiking at all.

highlights.sr: Šetnja starim gradom Kotorom i brojanje mačaka koje se izležavaju na trgovima
highlights.en: Wandering Kotor's old town and counting the cats dozing on its squares

highlights.sr: Vožnja brodićem do Perasta i ostrvceta Gospa od Škrpjela
highlights.en: A boat trip to Perast and the tiny island of Our Lady of the Rocks

highlights.sr: Lagana šetnja rivom i sladoled uz zaliv
highlights.en: A gentle waterfront promenade with ice cream along the bay

highlights.sr: Igranje na gradskim trgovima dok roditelji piju kafu
highlights.en: Playing on the town squares while parents enjoy a coffee

pros.sr: Stari grad je pešačka zona — deca se kreću bezbedno bez automobila
pros.en: The old town is car-free, so children move around safely

pros.sr: Brodići su kratki i mirni, idealni i za bebe
pros.en: Boat trips are short and calm, fine even with a baby

pros.sr: Kafa i sladoled na svakom koraku, uz mnogo hlada pod starim zidinama
pros.en: Coffee and ice cream on every corner, with plenty of shade under the old walls

pros.sr: Zaliv štiti od jakih talasa, pa je kupanje mirnije nego na otvorenom moru
pros.en: The sheltered bay has no big waves, so swimming is calmer than the open sea

cons.sr: Leti ume da bude vrelo i krcato, posebno kad pristanu brodovi za krstarenje
cons.en: It gets hot and crowded in summer, especially when cruise ships dock

cons.sr: Kaldrma je neravna — kolica ćete često nositi ili ostaviti kod hotela
cons.en: The cobbles are uneven — you'll often carry the buggy or leave it at the hotel

cons.sr: Penjanje na tvrđavu Sveti Ivan (1.350 stepenika) nije za malu decu
cons.en: The climb to St John's fortress (1,350 steps) is not for small children

tip.sr: Tvrđavu obiđite rano ujutru pre vrućine — ili je preskočite i provozajte se žičarom Kotor–Lovćen, koja pruža isti pogled bez ijednog stepenika.

season.sr: Park je najlepši od juna do septembra, kada je snega nestalo i kada rade staze; zimi je u ponudi miran porodični odmor u snegu.
season.en: The park is at its best from June to September once the snow has gone and the trails are open; winter offers a quiet family break in the snow.

tagline.sr: Planinsko Crno jezero do kog se šeta ravnom stazom, uz svež vazduh i divlje konje na proplancima.
tagline.en: The mountain Black Lake reached by a flat trail, with fresh air and wild horses on the meadows.

description.sr: Durmitor je najlepša planina Crne Gore — nacionalni park s vrhovima preko 2.000 metara, kanjonom Tare i tirkiznim Crnim jezerom. Najveća porodična atrakcija je lagana šetnja oko Crnog jezera (oko 3,5 km), koja je ravna i prikladna i za mlađu decu. Leti je na Žabljaku prijatno sveže, što je pravo osveženje posle vrele obale. Uz stazu ćete sresti krave, ovce, a ponekad i divlje konje.
description.en: Durmitor is Montenegro's most beautiful mountain — a national park of 2,000 m peaks, the Tara canyon and the turquoise Black Lake. The big family draw is a gentle ~3.5 km loop around the Black Lake, flat and easy even for younger children. In summer Žabljak stays pleasantly cool, a real escape from the hot coast. Along the trail you'll meet cows, sheep and sometimes wild horses.

highlights.sr: Lagana šetnja oko Crnog jezera (oko sat i po, ravna staza)
highlights.en: A gentle loop around the Black Lake (about 1.5 hours, flat)

highlights.sr: Iznajmljivanje čamca na Crnom jezeru
highlights.en: Renting a rowing boat on the Black Lake

highlights.sr: Posmatranje krava i divljih konja na proplancima
highlights.en: Watching cows and wild horses on the meadows

highlights.sr: Kratka šetnja do vidikovca s pogledom na vrhove
highlights.en: A short walk to a viewpoint over the peaks

pros.sr: Svež planinski vazduh i blaga klima leti — idealno za bebe i malu decu
pros.en: Cool mountain air and a mild climate in summer — great for babies and toddlers

pros.en: The lake trail is flat and wide, easier for buggies than the coast

pros.sr: Puno zelenila, livada i životinja koje deca obožavaju
pros.en: Lots of greenery, meadows and animals that children love

pros.en: Affordable — cheaper stays and food than the seaside

cons.sr: Letnje popodnevne oluje znaju da pokvare plan šetnje — krenite ujutru
cons.en: Afternoon thunderstorms can spoil a walk in summer — start in the morning

season.sr: Park je otvoren cele godine, ali je najlepši od maja do septembra, kada su izvori bistri i drvored u punom hladu.
season.en: The park is open year-round but is at its best from May to September, when the springs are clear and the avenue is in full shade.

tagline.sr: Izvor reke Bosne — park bistrih potočića, labudova i hladovine, idealan za popodnevnu šetnju s kolicima.
tagline.en: The source of the River Bosna — a park of clear streams, swans and shade, perfect for an afternoon walk with the buggy.

description.sr: Vrelo Bosne je zaštićeni park u podnožju Igmana, na samom izvoru reke Bosne — sistem bistrih izvora, potočića i drvenih mostića okružen starim platanima i kestenovima. Do izvora vodi ravna, mirna aleja Velika aleja (oko 3 km) zatvorena za automobile, pa se po njoj šeta, vozi bicikl ili fijakerom. Labudovi i patke plivaju po jezercima i rado se hrane iz ruke, što mališane oduševljava. Ulaz je simboličan, a kafa uz vodu u hladu je savršena završnica.
description.en: Vrelo Bosne is a protected park at the foot of Mount Igman, at the very source of the River Bosna — a network of clear springs, streams and wooden footbridges under old plane and chestnut trees. A flat, traffic-free avenue (about 3 km) leads to the spring, so you walk, cycle or take a horse-drawn carriage. Swans and ducks glide on the ponds and happily feed from your hand, which delights small children. Entry costs next to nothing, and a coffee by the water in the shade is a perfect finish.

highlights.sr: Šetnja ili vožnja fijakerom Velikom alejom do izvora
highlights.en: Walking or taking a horse-drawn carriage up the grand avenue

highlights.sr: Hranjenje labudova i patki na jezercima
highlights.en: Feeding the swans and ducks on the ponds

highlights.sr: Preskakanje drvenih mostića preko bistrih potoka
highlights.en: Hopping over wooden footbridges across the clear streams

highlights.sr: Kafa i sok u restoranu uz izvore
highlights.en: Coffee and juice at the restaurant by the springs

pros.en: Calm and green, away from the city buzz yet close to Sarajevo

pros.sr: Labudovi i patke su blaga atrakcija koju deca dugo pamte
pros.en: The swans and ducks are a gentle attraction children remember

cons.en: It can get crowded on summer weekends and parking is harder to find

cons.en: The spring water is drinkable but not recommended for small children — bring your own bottle

season.sr: Vodopad Kravica je najbolji od aprila do oktobra, kada se može i kupati; zimi je ulaz slobodan ali su objekti uglavnom zatvoreni.
season.en: Kravica waterfall is best from April to October when you can swim; in winter entry is free but most facilities close.

tagline.sr: Stari most u Mostaru i tirkizni vodopad Kravica — dva bisera Hercegovine u jednom danu.
tagline.en: The Old Bridge in Mostar and the turquoise Kravica waterfall you can swim under in summer — two gems of Herzegovina in one day.

description.sr: Ovaj izlet spaja dva lica Hercegovine: istorijski stari grad Mostar sa čuvenim Starim mostom i prirodni biser — vodopad Kravica visok 25 metara. U Mostaru šetate kaldrmom, kupujete suvenire i gledate skakače s mosta (iz sigurne daljine), a zatim se pola sata vožnje kasnije brčkate pod vodopadom. Podno Kravice je plitko i leti ugodno toplo, pa je kupanje pravo osveženje. Deca vole i kratku vožnju vlakićem uz stazu.
description.en: This trip combines two faces of Herzegovina: the historic old town of Mostar with its famous Old Bridge, and a natural gem — the 25 m Kravica waterfall. In Mostar you stroll the cobbles, buy souvenirs and watch the bridge divers (from a safe distance), then half an hour later you're paddling beneath the falls. The water under Kravica is shallow and pleasantly warm in summer, so swimming is a real treat. Kids also love the little train ride up the trail.

highlights.sr: Šetnja starim Mostarom i fotografisanje ispod Starog mosta
highlights.en: Wandering old Mostar and taking photos under the Old Bridge

highlights.sr: Kupanje i prskanje u plitkoj vodi podno vodopada Kravica
highlights.en: Swimming and splashing in the shallow water beneath Kravica

highlights.en: A short train ride from the car park to the waterfall

highlights.en: Ice cream and coffee on the terraces along the Neretva

pros.en: Kravica is shallow and calm — safer for small children than open water

pros.sr: Dva različita doživljaja (grad + priroda) u jednom danu
pros.en: Two different experiences (city + nature) in one day

pros.sr: Pristupačne cene, a deca do 7 godina ulaze besplatno
pros.en: Affordable prices, and children under 7 enter free

pros.sr: Mostar je kompaktan i pešački — sve se obiđe lagano
pros.en: Mostar is compact and walkable — everything is easily covered

cons.en: Kravica gets very busy in summer — arrive early in the morning

season.sr: Ohrid je najlepši od maja do septembra, kada je jezero toplo za kupanje i kada voze brodići; grad je otvoren cele godine.
season.en: Ohrid is at its best from May to September, when the lake is warm for swimming and the boats run; the town is open all year.

tagline.sr: Najdublje jezero Balkana sa crkvicom na steni i kristalno čistom vodom za prvo kupanje.
tagline.en: The Balkans' deepest lake, with a church on a cliff, a stone old town and crystal-clear water for first swimming strokes.

description.sr: Ohrid, na obali istoimenog jezera, jedno je od najstarijih i najlepših mesta na Balkanu — stari grad i jezero pod zaštitom su UNESKO-a. Najpoznatiji prizor, crkvica Svetog Jovana Kaneo na steni iznad vode, dočekuje vas kratkom šetnjom kroz stare ulice. Jezero je izuzetno čisto i plitko uz obalu, pa je idealno za prve plivačke korake, a brodići do Svetog Nauma pružaju dnevni izlet bez umora. Grad je miran, sa puno kafića uz šetalište i sladoleda na svakom ćošku.
description.en: Ohrid, on the shore of its namesake lake, is one of the oldest and most beautiful places in the Balkans — its old town and lake are UNESCO-listed. The most famous sight, the church of St John at Kaneo on a cliff above the water, is reached by a short stroll through the old lanes. The lake is exceptionally clean and shallow near the shore, ideal for first swimming strokes, and boats to St Naum make an easy day trip. The town is calm, with cafés along the promenade and ice cream on every corner.

highlights.en: Walking to St John at Kaneo church and photographing it above the lake

highlights.en: Swimming at the shallow town beaches along the promenade

highlights.en: Strolling the old bazaar for souvenirs and ice cream

pros.sr: Sve glavne znamenitosti su na kratkoj šetnji od centra

season.sr: Sezona traje od maja do oktobra, s najlepšim vremenom u junu i septembru; van sezone Ksamil je uglavnom zatvoren.
season.en: The season runs from May to October, with the best weather in June and September; out of season Ksamil mostly shuts down.

tagline.sr: Tirkizna plitka voda i tri ostrvceta do kojih se stiže plivanjem — uz antički Butrint nadomak plaže.
tagline.en: Turquoise shallow water and three islets you can swim out to — with ancient Butrint just beside the beach.

description.sr: Ksamil, na albanskoj rivijeri, čuven je po kristalno tirkiznoj, plitkoj vodi i peščanim uvalama u kojima deca bezbedno brčkaju. Pred obalom leže tri mala ostrvceta do kojih se starija deca mogu lagano doplivati ili doveslati. Samo par kilometara dalje je Butrint — veličanstveni antički grad pod zaštitom UNESKO-a, gde se kroz senovite staze i pozorište šeta kao kroz muzej na otvorenom. Kombinacija plaže i blage arheologije čini ovo idealnim porodičnim odmorom.
description.en: Ksamil, on the Albanian Riviera, is famous for its crystal-turquoise, shallow water and sandy coves where children splash safely. Three little islets lie just offshore, close enough for older kids to swim or paddle out to. Only a few kilometres away is Butrint — a magnificent UNESCO-listed ancient city, where shaded paths and a theatre make it feel like an open-air museum. The mix of beach and gentle archaeology makes this an ideal family holiday.

highlights.sr: Brčkanje u plitkoj tirkiznoj vodi peščanih uvala
highlights.en: Splashing in the shallow turquoise water of the sandy coves

highlights.sr: Plivanje ili veslanje do tri ostrvceta pred Ksamilom
highlights.en: Swimming or paddling out to the three islets off Ksamil

highlights.en: Walking the shaded paths and theatre of ancient Butrint

highlights.en: A boat ride along the coast and watching fish through a mask

pros.en: The water is shallow and clear — among the safest beaches for small children

pros.en: Butrint offers shade and an easy walk, and children under 12 enter free

pros.sr: Povoljne cene u odnosu na grčka ostrva prekoputa
pros.en: Affordable prices compared with the Greek islands opposite

pros.sr: Smeštaj je uglavnom odmah uz plažu
pros.en: Most accommodation sits right by the beach

cons.sr: Jula i avgusta plaže su krcate, a ležaljke se naplaćuju
cons.en: In July and August the beaches are packed and sunbeds cost extra

cons.sr: Dolazak je preko Krfa trajektom — duže putovanje nego što karta pokazuje
cons.en: You reach it via a ferry from Corfu — a longer journey than the map suggests

cons.en: There's little shade on the beach itself in summer — bring a parasol

season.sr: Albena živi od maja do septembra, a najlepša je u junu i septembru; van sezone resort je uglavnom zatvoren.
season.en: Albena runs from May to September, at its best in June and September; out of season the resort mostly closes.

tagline.sr: Dugačka plitka peščana plaža sa svim sadržajima, uz bajkovitu botaničku baštu i dvorac u Balčiku.
tagline.en: A long, shallow sandy beach with every convenience, plus the fairytale botanical garden and palace in Balchik.

description.sr: Albena je jedan od najuređenijih porodičnih resorta na crnomorskoj obali Bugarske — duga peščana plaža, blaga plitka voda i široko šetalište s parkovima i igralištima. Desetak minuta vožnje dalje je Balčik, gde se nalazi dvorac kraljice Marije i čuvena botanička bašta sa kaktusima i terasama prema moru. Sve je prilagođeno deci — od mini-klubova u hotelima do ravnih staza za kolica. Idealno za prvi pravi porodični odmor uz more.
description.en: Albena is one of the best-kept family resorts on Bulgaria's Black Sea coast — a long sandy beach, gentle shallow water and a wide promenade with parks and playgrounds. Ten minutes away is Balchik, home to Queen Marie's palace and the famous botanical garden with cacti and terraces above the sea. Everything is geared to children — from hotel kids' clubs to flat paths for buggies. Ideal for a first proper family seaside holiday.

highlights.en: A full day on the long sandy beach with shallow water

highlights.sr: Šetnja botaničkom baštom u Balčiku među kaktusima i cvećem
highlights.en: Walking the Balchik botanical garden among cacti and flowers

highlights.sr: Razgledanje dvorca kraljice Marije i terasa nad morem
highlights.en: Seeing Queen Marie's palace and its terraces above the sea

highlights.sr: Večernja šetnja šetalištem uz ringišpil i sladoled
highlights.en: An evening promenade with a carousel and ice cream

pros.sr: Široka peščana plaža i plitka voda — najbezbednije za najmlađe
pros.en: A wide sandy beach and shallow water — the safest for the youngest

pros.sr: Resort je ravan i uređen, idealan za kolica
pros.en: The resort is flat and well-kept, ideal for buggies

pros.sr: Puno hotela s dečjim sadržajima i animacijom
pros.en: Lots of hotels with kids' clubs and animation

pros.sr: Balčik dodaje dozu istorije i zelenila za kišne dane
pros.en: Balchik adds a dose of history and greenery for rainy days

cons.sr: Sezona je kratka, a u julu i avgustu plaža je vrlo posećena
cons.en: The season is short, and in July and August the beach is very busy

cons.sr: Veliki deo plaže čine ležaljke koje se doplaćuju
cons.en: Much of the beach is covered in paid sunbeds

cons.sr: Botanička bašta ima dosta stepenica i strmih terena — kolica će nositi
cons.en: The botanical garden has many steps and steep paths — you'll carry the buggy

tip.sr: Kupite porodični paket ulaznica za dvorac i botaničku baštu — isplati se s dvoje i više dece, a deca do 6 godina ulaze besplatno.
tip.en: Buy the family ticket package for the palace and garden — it pays off with two or more children, and under-6s enter free.

season.sr: Leti (jun–septembar) je raj za šetnje i žičaru, a zimi (decembar–april) mirno porodično skijalište s blagim stazama.
season.en: Summer (June–September) is for walks and the gondola; winter (December–April) is a gentle family ski resort with easy slopes.

tagline.sr: Planinsko mesto pod Pirinom — leti zelene livade i žičara, zimi blage staze za prve skijaške korake.
tagline.en: A mountain town under the Pirin range — green meadows and the gondola in summer, gentle slopes for first ski turns in winter.

description.sr: Bansko je najpoznatije skijalište Bugarske u podnožju Pirina, ali leti je jednako privlačno porodicama — žičara vozi do visokih livada s pogledom na najviši vrh Vihren, a staze su lake i široke. Zimi su obronci blagi i idealni za školu skijanja za decu od 4–5 godina, uz mnogo ski vrtića. Mesto je živo cele godine, s tavernama, pekarama i toplim kafićima. Dobar izbor i za leto u prirodi i za prvi porodični odmor na snegu.
description.en: Bansko is Bulgaria's best-known ski resort at the foot of the Pirin mountains, but it's just as appealing to families in summer — the gondola rises to high meadows with views of Vihren, the country's highest peak, and the trails are easy and wide. In winter the slopes are gentle and ideal for ski school from age 4–5, with plenty of ski kindergartens. The town is lively all year, with taverns, bakeries and warm cafés. A good pick both for a summer in nature and a first family trip to the snow.

highlights.sr: Vožnja žičarom do planinskih livada i pogled na vrh Vihren
highlights.en: A gondola ride to the mountain meadows and a view of Vihren

highlights.sr: Lagane šetnje i branje borovnica na proplancima leti
highlights.en: Easy walks and blueberry picking on the slopes in summer

highlights.sr: Škola skijanja i sanjkanje zimi na blagim stazama
highlights.en: Ski school and sledging on the gentle slopes in winter

highlights.sr: Šetnja starim delom Banska i večera u taverni
highlights.en: A stroll through old Bansko and dinner in a tavern

pros.sr: Blage i široke staze zimi — među najpovoljnijim mestima za učenje skijanja
pros.en: Gentle, wide slopes in winter — among the cheapest places to learn to ski

pros.sr: Leti prijatno sveže, daleko od gradske vrućine
pros.en: Pleasantly cool in summer, far from city heat

pros.sr: Žičara radi i leti, a deca do 7 godina se voze skoro besplatno
pros.en: The gondola runs in summer too, and under-7s ride almost free

pros.sr: Puno povoljnog smeštaja i domaće hrane
pros.en: Plenty of affordable stays and home cooking

cons.sr: Zimi ume da bude hladno, a vikendom se za žičaru dugo čeka
cons.en: It can be cold in winter, and at weekends the gondola queue is long

cons.sr: Glavna sezona je zimska — leti su neki objekti zatvoreni
cons.en: Peak season is winter — some places close in summer

cons.sr: Stari deo grada ima kaldrmu, a planinske staze nisu za kolica
cons.en: The old town is cobbled and the mountain trails aren't for buggies

tip.sr: Ako dolazite zimi, kupite kartu za žičaru i časove skijanja online unapred — izbegavate jutarnje redove i dobijate popust.
tip.en: In winter, buy your gondola pass and ski lessons online in advance — you skip the morning queues and get a discount.

season.sr: Brašov i zamak Bran su otvoreni cele godine, a najlepši su od maja do oktobra; zimi je bajkovito uz snežni Božićni sajam.
season.en: Brașov and Bran Castle are open all year, at their best from May to October; winter is fairytale-like with a snowy Christmas market.

tagline.sr: Srednjovekovni Brašov pod Tampom i čuveni Drakulin zamak Bran — bajka za decu stariju od tri godine.
tagline.en: Medieval Brașov beneath Mount Tâmpa and the famous Dracula's castle at Bran — a fairytale for children over three.

description.sr: Brašov je najlepši grad Transilvanije — šareni stari grad, najuži sokak u Evropi i Crna crkva, a nad njim se diže planina Tampa. Pola sata vožnje dalje je zamak Bran, koji deca znaju kao „Drakulin dvorac“ — pravi bajkoviti dvorac na steni sa 57 soba i dvorištem. Leti je grad prijatan i pun terasa, zimi uz Božićni sajam. Deca mlađa od 7 godina u zamak ulaze besplatno.
description.en: Brașov is Transylvania's most beautiful city — a colourful old town, Europe's narrowest alley and the Black Church, overlooked by Mount Tâmpa. Half an hour away is Bran Castle, which children know as 'Dracula's castle' — a real fairytale fortress on a rock with 57 rooms and a courtyard. The city is pleasant and full of terraces in summer, and has a Christmas market in winter. Children under 7 enter the castle free.

highlights.sr: Šetnja šarenim trgom Piața Sfatului i sokacima starog Brašova
highlights.en: Strolling Piața Sfatului and the alleys of old Brașov

highlights.sr: Razgledanje zamka Bran — traženje „Drakulinih“ tajni u 57 soba
highlights.en: Exploring Bran Castle — hunting for 'Dracula' secrets in its 57 rooms

highlights.sr: Vožnja žičarom na Tampu i pogled na grad
highlights.en: A cable-car ride up Tâmpa for a view over the city

highlights.sr: Kafa i sladoled na terasama uz Crnu crkvu
highlights.en: Coffee and ice cream on the terraces by the Black Church

pros.sr: Zamak Bran deca mlađa od 7 godina obilaze besplatno
pros.en: Children under 7 visit Bran Castle free

pros.sr: Grad je kompaktan i pešački — sve je blizu
pros.en: The city is compact and walkable — everything is close

pros.sr: Puno zelenila i planina nadomak grada za brze izlete
pros.en: Plenty of greenery and mountains on the doorstep for quick trips

pros.sr: Dobra baza i za jednodnevni izlet do Sinaje i zamka Peleš
pros.en: A good base for a day trip to Sinaia and Peleș Castle

cons.en: The castle has many stairs and narrow passages — no buggies

cons.en: Bran is very busy on weekends and in summer

cons.en: The old town's cobbles are uneven for buggies

tip.sr: U zamak Bran idite radnim danom rano ujutru i ponesite nosiljku za bebu umesto kolica — uštedećete i na vremenu i na živcima.
tip.en: Go to Bran Castle early on a weekday and bring a baby carrier instead of the buggy — you'll save time and nerves.

season.sr: Muzej ASTRA je leti (maj–septembar) otvoren duže i življi; zimi radi kraće, a zatvoren je oko Božića i Nove godine.
season.en: The ASTRA museum keeps longer, livelier hours in summer (May–September); winter hours are shorter, with closures around Christmas and New Year.

tagline.sr: Najveći muzej na otvorenom u Evropi — sela, vetrenjače i životinje u šumi, pa i vožnja vlakićem.
tagline.en: Europe's largest open-air museum — villages, windmills and animals in a forest, plus a little train ride.

description.sr: Muzej ASTRA kod Sibija najveći je etnografski muzej na otvorenom u Evropi — 96 hektara šume u kojoj se nalazi preko 400 seoskih kuća, vetrenjača i vodenica iz cele Rumunije. Staze su široke i šumovite, pa je i leti prijatno hladovito, a decu posebno oduševljavaju domaće životinje i vlakić koji vozi kroz muzej. Sibiu je i sam šarmantan grad s očima na krovovima i najlepšim trgovima Transilvanije. Idealno za poludnevni izlet u prirodi s daškom istorije.
description.en: The ASTRA museum near Sibiu is Europe's largest open-air ethnographic museum — 96 hectares of forest holding over 400 village houses, windmills and watermills from across Romania. The paths are wide and wooded, so it stays pleasantly shady in summer, and children are especially thrilled by the farm animals and the little train that runs through the museum. Sibiu itself is a charming city with 'eyes' on its rooftops and some of Transylvania's loveliest squares. Ideal for a half-day nature outing with a touch of history.

highlights.sr: Vožnja vlakićem kroz šumu i sela muzeja ASTRA
highlights.en: A little train ride through the museum's forest and villages

highlights.sr: Gledanje domaćih životinja i vetrenjača na jezeru Dumbrava
highlights.en: Seeing farm animals and windmills on Lake Dumbrava

highlights.sr: Istraživanje seoskih kućica i radionica starih zanata
highlights.en: Exploring the village houses and old-craft workshops

highlights.sr: Šetnja starim Sibiom i traženje „očiju“ na krovovima
highlights.en: Strolling old Sibiu and hunting for 'eyes' on the rooftops

pros.sr: Ogroman prostor u prirodi gde deca mogu da trče i istražuju
pros.en: A huge outdoor space where children can run and explore

pros.en: Wide forest paths suitable for buggies

pros.sr: Vlakić i životinje drže pažnju i najmlađima
pros.en: The little train and animals hold even the youngest's attention

pros.en: Cheap entry, with children paying a token amount

cons.en: Some paths are gravelly and the houses have steps

cons.sr: Izvan glavne sezone radi kraće i manji deo sadržaja
cons.en: Outside peak season the hours are shorter and fewer things are open

tip.en: Buy the train ticket right at the entrance — it saves little legs many kilometres, and riding is the most fun part of the visit for kids.

season.sr: Otvoreno cele godine — i po najvećoj hladnoći i kiši unutra je tropski toplo, pa je idealno za jesen i zimu.
season.en: Open all year — even in the deepest cold or rain it's tropical inside, making it ideal for autumn and winter.

tagline.sr: Najveći tropski vodeni park u Evropi pod staklom — tobogani i talasi za decu, topla voda i mir za roditelje.
tagline.en: Europe's largest glass-roofed tropical water park — slides and waves for kids, warm water and calm for parents.

description.sr: Terme Bukurešt su ogroman vodeni kompleks pod staklenom kupolom, uvek zagrejan na tropskih 30 stepeni, s palmama, toboganima i bazenskim talasima. Dečja zona Galaksi ima sistem tobogana, talasni bazen i animaciju, a deca do 3 godine ulaze besplatno. Roditelji mogu da se prebace u mirniju zonu Palm sa mineralnim bazenima i ležaljkama. Kako je sve u zatvorenom, ovo je savršen „beg od lošeg vremena“ — naročito zimi i za kišne dane.
description.en: Therme Bucharest is a huge water complex under a glass dome, always heated to a tropical 30°C, with palm trees, slides and wave pools. The Galaxy kids' zone has a slide system, a wave pool and activities, and children under 3 enter free. Parents can move to the calmer Palm zone with mineral pools and loungers. Because it's all indoors, this is the perfect 'bad-weather escape' — especially in winter and on rainy days.

highlights.sr: Tobogani i talasni bazen u dečjoj zoni Galaksi
highlights.en: Slides and the wave pool in the Galaxy kids' zone

highlights.sr: Topli mineralni bazeni i ležaljke u zoni Palm
highlights.en: Warm mineral pools and loungers in the Palm zone

highlights.sr: Igranje među palmama uz tropsku temperaturu cele godine
highlights.en: Playing among palm trees at tropical temperatures all year

highlights.sr: Bazen na otvorenom s toplom vodom i zimi
highlights.en: An outdoor pool with warm water even in winter

pros.sr: Toplo i suvo unutra bez obzira na vreme napolju — odlično za kišne i hladne dane
pros.en: Warm and dry inside whatever the weather outside — great for rainy and cold days

pros.sr: Deca do 3 godine ulaze besplatno, a postoji porodični paket 2+2
pros.en: Children under 3 enter free, and there's a 2+2 family pass

pros.sr: Čisto, uređeno i bezbedno, s plićacima i toboganima za različite uzraste
pros.en: Clean, well-run and safe, with shallow pools and slides for different ages

pros.sr: Blizu aerodroma OTP — lako se kombinuje s dolaskom ili odlaskom
pros.en: Close to OTP airport — easy to combine with arrival or departure

cons.sr: Cena raste s dužinom boravka i vikendom — nije jeftino
cons.en: The price rises with length of stay and on weekends — not cheap

cons.sr: Vikendom i praznicima ume da bude velika gužva
cons.en: It can get very crowded on weekends and holidays

cons.sr: Dečje zone i tobogani imaju visinska i uzrasna ograničenja
cons.en: The kids' zones and slides have height and age limits

tip.sr: Idite radnim danom pre podne i uzmite paket od 3 sata — za malu decu to je sasvim dovoljno, a izbegavate vikend gužvu i skuplje cene.
tip.en: Go on a weekday morning and take the 3-hour pass — plenty for small children, and you avoid weekend crowds and higher prices.

season.sr: Rudnik je otvoren cele godine i unutra je stalnih 10–12 stepeni — leti prija hladovina, a zimi je toplije nego napolju.
season.en: The mine is open all year and stays at a constant 10–12°C inside — a cool refuge in summer, warmer than outdoors in winter.

tagline.sr: Čudesan rudnik soli sa podzemnim jezerom, čamcem i ringišpilom — drugi svet 120 metara pod zemljom.
tagline.en: A marvellous salt mine with an underground lake, boat and ferris wheel — another world 120 metres down.

description.sr: Salina Turda je stari rudnik soli pretvoren u spektakularnu podzemnu atrakciju — ogromne dvorane isklesane u soli, podzemno jezero s čamcem i čak ringišpil u dubini. Stalna temperatura od 10–12 stepeni čini ga prijatnim i leti i zimi, a čist vazduh bogat soli mnogi smatraju blagotvornim za disanje. Deca do 3 godine ulaze besplatno (uz lekarsku potvrdu), a stariji vole vožnju čamcem i igralište u dvorani. Ceo doživljaj je kao silazak u čarobni drugi svet.
description.en: Salina Turda is an old salt mine turned into a spectacular underground attraction — vast halls carved in salt, an underground lake with a boat and even a ferris wheel in the depths. A constant 10–12°C makes it pleasant in summer and winter alike, and the clean, salt-rich air is widely thought to help breathing. Children under 3 enter free (with a medical note), while older ones love the boat ride and the play area in the hall. The whole experience feels like descending into a magical other world.

highlights.en: A boat ride on the underground Terezia lake

highlights.sr: Ringišpil u dvorani duboko pod zemljom
highlights.en: A ferris wheel in a hall deep underground

highlights.sr: Šetnja slanim dvoranama i traženje sjajnih kristala soli
highlights.en: Walking the salt halls and hunting for glistening salt crystals

highlights.sr: Spuštanje liftom 120 metara u dubinu
highlights.en: Riding the lift 120 metres down

pros.en: A constant pleasant temperature all year — good in both heat and winter

pros.sr: Podzemni svet je uzbudljiv za decu, a tlo je ravno i uredno
pros.en: The underground world is exciting for kids, and the floors are flat and well-kept

pros.en: Children under 3 enter free

pros.sr: Povoljne cene i hrana u okolini
pros.en: Affordable prices and food in the area

cons.en: Children under 3 need a medical note to enter

cons.sr: Vikendom leti može biti gužva i čekanja na lift

tip.en: Bring a light long-sleeved layer and comfy shoes — it stays cool underground and the halls involve a fair bit of walking.

season.sr: Zamak Peleš je zatvoren ponedeljkom i utorkom; najlepši je od maja do oktobra, a zimi je bajkovit uz sneg.
season.en: Peleș Castle is closed Mondays and Tuesdays; it's at its best from May to October, and fairytale-like under snow in winter.

tagline.sr: Nemački bajkoviti dvorac rumunskih kraljeva u podnožju Bučegija — najlepši zamak u Rumuniji za malu decu.
tagline.en: The German-style fairytale palace of Romania's kings at the foot of the Bucegi — Romania's prettiest castle for small children.

description.sr: Zamak Peleš u Sinaji, letnjoj rezidenciji rumunskih kraljeva, jedan je od najlepših dvoraca u Evropi — neo-renesansna bajka sa tornjevima, rezbarenim drvetom i 160 soba. Nalazi se u parku u podnožju planine Bučegi, pa se poseta lako kombinuje sa šetnjom šumom ili vožnjom žičarom. Deca mlađa od 7 godina ulaze besplatno, a osnovni obilazak prizemlja je kratak i dovoljan za njihovu pažnju. Sinaja je mirno planinsko mesto, idealno za porodični izlet iz Bukurešta.
description.en: Peleș Castle in Sinaia, summer residence of Romania's kings, is one of Europe's most beautiful palaces — a neo-Renaissance fairytale of turrets, carved wood and 160 rooms. It sits in a park at the foot of the Bucegi mountains, so a visit is easily combined with a forest walk or a cable-car ride. Children under 7 enter free, and the basic ground-floor tour is short enough to hold their attention. Sinaia is a quiet mountain town, ideal for a family trip from Bucharest.

highlights.sr: Šetnja parkom i šumskim stazama u podnožju Bučegija
highlights.en: Walking the park and forest trails at the foot of the Bucegi

highlights.sr: Vožnja žičarom na planinu i pogled na Sinaju
highlights.en: A cable-car ride up the mountain with views over Sinaia

highlights.sr: Kafa i kolači u starinskim kafićima Sinaje
highlights.en: Coffee and cakes in Sinaia's old-style cafés

pros.en: Children under 7 enter free

pros.sr: Park i šuma oko zamka nude prostor za trčanje i piknik
pros.en: The park and forest around the castle offer space to run and picnic

pros.sr: Osnovni obilazak je kratak i ne zamara malu decu
pros.en: The basic tour is short and doesn't tire small children

pros.sr: Lako se kombinuje s Brašovom i zamkom Bran u istom putovanju
pros.en: Easily combined with Brașov and Bran Castle on one trip

cons.sr: Zatvoreno ponedeljkom i utorkom — planirajte druge dane
cons.en: Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays — plan other days

cons.en: Inside there are stairs and narrow passages, no buggies

cons.sr: Parking uz zamak je ograničen i plaća se
cons.en: Parking by the castle is limited and paid

tip.sr: Rezervišite karte online unapred i uzmite osnovni obilazak prizemlja — deci je to sasvim dovoljno, a izbegavate red i duži, skuplji obilazak.
tip.en: Book online in advance and take the basic ground-floor tour — enough for children, and you skip the queue and the longer, pricier tour.

season.sr: Delta je najlepša od aprila do oktobra; u julu i avgustu ima više komaraca, pa su maj, jun i septembar najprijatniji.
season.en: The delta is at its best from April to October; mosquitoes peak in July and August, so May, June and September are most pleasant.

tagline.sr: Labirint kanala, trske i ptica — vožnja čamcem kroz najveću močvaru Evrope s pelikanima nad glavom.
tagline.en: A maze of channels, reeds and birds — a boat ride through Europe's largest wetland with pelicans overhead.

description.sr: Delta Dunava, pod zaštitom UNESKO-a, najveća je rečna delta u Evropi — beskrajni labirint kanala, jezera i tršćaka u kome živi preko 300 vrsta ptica, među njima i veliki beli pelikani. Ceo doživljaj vrti se oko vožnje čamcem: mirno klizanje kroz kanale dok deca traže ptice, kornjače i lokvanje. Najprijatniji meseci su maj, jun i septembar, kad nema mnogo komaraca. Idealno za porodice koje vole prirodu i mir, a mogu i u posetu selu Letea s divljim konjima.
description.en: The Danube Delta, a UNESCO site, is Europe's largest river delta — an endless maze of channels, lakes and reed beds home to over 300 bird species, including great white pelicans. The whole experience revolves around a boat ride: gliding quietly through the channels while children spot birds, turtles and water lilies. The most pleasant months are May, June and September, when mosquitoes are scarce. Ideal for families who love nature and calm, with an optional trip to Letea village and its wild horses.

highlights.sr: Vožnja čamcem kroz kanale i traženje pelikana i čaplji
highlights.en: A boat ride through the channels hunting for pelicans and herons

highlights.sr: Posmatranje ptica kroz dvogled — takmičenje ko će prvi ugledati pelikana
highlights.en: Birdwatching through binoculars — a race to spot the first pelican

highlights.sr: Izlet do sela Letea i divljih konja u peščanim dinama
highlights.en: A trip to Letea village and its wild horses in the sand dunes

highlights.sr: Ručak od sveže ribe u porodičnoj kući uz kanal
highlights.en: A fresh-fish lunch at a family guesthouse by the channel

pros.sr: Mirna voda i lagana vožnja — opuštajuće i za bebe
pros.en: Calm water and a gentle ride — relaxing even with a baby

pros.sr: Priroda na dohvat ruke, bez gužvi i buke
pros.en: Nature up close, with no crowds or noise

pros.sr: Deca uče o pticama i prirodi dok se zabavljaju
pros.en: Children learn about birds and nature while having fun

pros.sr: Puno smeštaja s domaćom kuhinjom i dvorištem za igru
pros.en: Lots of guesthouses with home cooking and a yard to play in

cons.sr: Jula i avgusta komarci mogu biti naporni — ponesite zaštitu
cons.en: In July and August mosquitoes can be a nuisance — bring repellent

cons.sr: Obilazak zavisi od čamca i vozača — nije klasična samostalna poseta
cons.en: Exploring depends on a boat and skipper — it's not a self-guided visit

cons.sr: Duga putovanja do polaznih tačaka i manje sadržaja za malu decu
cons.en: Long transfers to the departure points and fewer facilities for small children

tip.sr: Rezervišite čamac unapred i idite ujutru — voda je tada najmirnija, ptice najaktivnije, a izbegavate podnevno sunce.
tip.en: Book your boat in advance and go in the morning — the water is calmest, the birds most active, and you avoid the midday sun.
